role: Draws the HRV report's header, summary hero (RMSSD + age-norm badge + readiness gauge + HR stats), metric grids (time/frequency/nonlinear/ANS/quality), analysis-window card, page footer with wellness disclaimer, auto-pagination, and the recovery score breakdown.
toplevel: Private static lets compositeBadgeHeight (28) and factorRowHeight (38). File-scope private helpers are listed as units.

units.does: Draws the header block from the top margin: brand+subtitle, session date/recording line, optional age/sex line; returns y below it.
Draws a 4×44pt primary accent bar and 'Emuqu' in the title font, then the subtitle.
Draws the localized 'Recovery Report' subtitle under the brand and returns y+50.
Draws the session info line (date and recording length / summary-import note) and returns y+18.
Draws 'Age: n  •  Sex: x' in caption grey when either is set (+16), then adds 14pt spacing (two consecutive += 7).

branches.effect: draws the line and advances 16; empty → skips the line

units.does: Reads user settings and returns localized 'Age: n' when age is set and 'Sex: x' when biological sex is set and not .other.
calls: closure:settingsProvider — PDFReportGenerator.init default reads AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager.settingsSnapshot; tests inject UserSettings()

units.does: Draws the summary hero then the HR stats row; returns y below.
Fills a 90pt grey rounded hero box, draws the big RMSSD value and the assessment, and a readiness gauge on the right using composite score/10 or else ANS readiness; returns y+100.

branches.effect: draws the gauge; nil → no gauge

units.does: Draws the RMSSD (48pt bold, coloured by age-norm category) with 'ms' after it, kept left-to-right on mirrored RTL pages.
Draws the 'HRV (RMSSD)' caption, the assessment badge and the age-context phrase.
x of the badge: margin + max(85, caption width + 28) so a long translated caption is not overlapped.
Draws the age-norm category label (Excellent…Low) in a 15%-tinted rounded badge in the category colour.

flags.text: The hero RMSSD colour and badge rate tonight's RMSSD against population age/sex norms (AgeAdjustedHRV.interpret), not the user's own baseline, while the report's summary rates HRV against the canonical baseline as Today does; a user with a naturally low RMSSD sees a red 'Low' hero on a night the rest of the report calls normal for them.

units.does: Re-measures the badge (8pt font) and draws the age-context phrase after it when an age is known.

flags.text: Positions the age-context phrase by re-measuring the badge label in an 8pt font while drawHeroBadge draws it at 9pt, so the computed badge is narrower than the drawn one; for a long (translated) label the 8pt gap is consumed and the phrase overlaps the badge.

units.does: Fills a 50pt stats row and draws four boxes: Min HR, Avg HR, Max HR (bpm) and SDNN (ms) from the analysis window; returns y+65.
Draws each HR stat in a quarter-width compact box.

flags.text: Same evenly-spaced compact-stat-box row loop as PDFReportGenerator.drawStatBoxRow (only the box height differs: statsHeight-12 vs 36).

units.does: Draws the readiness gauge: arcs, score text and 'Recovery' label.
Saves state, strokes the grey track and the coloured sweep, restores state.
Strokes an 8pt round-capped arc from 135° spanning 270°×score/10 in the readiness colour (score is not clamped to 0–10).
Draws the score (1 decimal, 18pt, readiness colour) centred and '/10' below.
Draws a 7pt grey title and a 13pt bold coloured value in the rect.
Maps settings biological sex to AgeAdjustedHRV.Sex and returns AgeAdjustedHRV.interpret(rmssd, age, sex).
Colour for the RMSSD age-norm category.
Localized label of the age-adjusted category.
Localized age-context phrase, nil when no age was known.
Gauge colour by 0–10 readiness: ≥7 green, ≥4.5 amber, ≥2 red accent, else dusty rose.

flags.text: Hard-codes the 7.0/4.5/2.0 tiers again instead of reading RecoveryScoreConstants.ReadinessLabels; the same ladder exists in AppTheme.readinessColor and ReadinessScoring.readinessLabel, so a threshold change must be made in three places.

units.does: Draws a 20pt bold value and caption title in a rect.

flags.text: drawSummaryBox has no caller anywhere in the repo (app or tests); grep finds only its declaration.

units.does: Draws 'Time Domain HRV' heading and a grid of Mean NN, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, Mean HR, SDSD and (if present) HRV triangular index; returns y+8.

flags.text: ARCHITECTURE.md and USERS_MANUAL.md list the full metric grids (time, frequency, nonlinear, ANS) as page-1 content of every report, but drawDetailedMetricTables (which calls these grid sections) runs only for style == .comprehensive with .deepDive selected, so Summary and Sleep presets have no metric grids.

units.does: Draws 'Frequency Domain HRV' heading and the frequency metric grid; returns y+8.
Draws 'Nonlinear HRV' heading and nonlinear grid; returns y+8.
Draws 'ANS Indexes' heading and the ANS grid; returns y+8.
Draws 'Data Quality' heading, the quality grid and the analysis-window caveat; returns y+30.
Draws the caption note that metrics come from a short selected window, not the full recording.
Draws 'Analysis Window' heading and a 70pt card with time range, window HR/stability and selection reason; returns y+80.
Fills the grey rounded card background.
When both window start/end ms exist, draws 'Time Range: m:ss – m:ss (duration)' (offsets into the recording) and advances 16.

branches.effect: draws the line, y+16; else nothing

units.does: Draws window mean HR then stability on one line; returns y+16.
Draws 'Window HR: n bpm' when present and shifts x by 100.

branches.effect: draws and returns x+100; nil → returns x unchanged

units.does: Draws 'Stability: <label> (CV: x.xx)' coloured by CV when stability exists.
Draws the localized window-selection reason, wrapped into a 24pt box, when non-empty.
Formats ms as h:mm:ss when ≥1 h else m:ss.
Formats a ms duration via PDFDurationText.minutesSeconds (seconds clamped into Int).
Localized stability label by coefficient of variation.
Stability colour by CV.
Draws the centred page footer line and the wellness disclaimer below it.
Draws centred 'Emuqu • Page n • <now, medium date short time>' 15pt below the bottom margin line; returns its size.
Draws the 'wellness and fitness use only; not a medical device' disclaimer under the footer, full content width.
Pagination: if y+needed exceeds pageHeight−bottomMargin−20, draws the footer, increments the page number, begins a new (RTL-mirrored if needed) page and returns the top margin; else returns y.

branches.effect: footer + new page, returns margins.top; false → returns y unchanged

units.does: Colour for a factor's impact.

flags.text: Doc comment says neutral factors are grey ('green helping, red hurting, grey neutral') but the code paints them systemYellow.

units.does: Draws 'Recovery Score Breakdown' heading, composite badge, verdict message, one bar per factor, vitals penalties and the weighted-average note; returns y below.

flags.text: The section has no internal pagination and its only caller reserves 120pt (ensureSpace(needed: 120)), but heading (20) + badge (28) + message (>=12) + one 42pt row per factor (three or more factors) already exceeds 190pt before penalties; when the section starts low on page 1 the factor rows are drawn past the bottom limit, over the footer and wellness disclaimer.

units.does: Fills a 28pt badge tinted by diagnosticColorForScore(composite) and draws score and tier labels; returns the same y (caller adds the badge height).

flags.text: The composite (0–100) badge is coloured by OvernightReportRenderer's 80/60/40 ladder, while the app colours the recovery score by the ScoreVerdict 90/75/60/45/30 ladder, so the same score can be a different colour in the PDF and in the app.

units.does: Draws the composite score (0 decimals, 16pt mono) and 'Tier n' caption inside the badge.
Draws the ScoreBreakdownCopy verdict message (with the advice gate's load level) wrapped across the content width under the badge; returns y after it +8.
Draws a row per factor, advancing 42pt each.

branches.effect: draws one row; no factors → y unchanged

units.does: Draws a factor row: grey background, impact dot, localized factor label (stored English key looked up in the app bundle), score×weight, progress bar and detail.
Draws right-aligned '<score> × <weight>%' kept left-to-right on mirrored pages.
Draws a grey 4pt track and a fill proportional to min(score,100)/100 in the impact colour, then the detail line.
Draws the factor's display detail (with the user's temperature unit) in 7.5pt, truncated to a 10pt-high rect inside the row.
When penalties exist, draws 'Vitals Penalties Applied:' and one '⚠ <penalty>' line per display penalty, then the explanation; returns y+28 past them.

branches.effect: returns y unchanged; else draws block

units.does: Draws a 7.5pt wrapped explanation that penalties are deducted after the weighted composite.
Computes weighted factor average; when penalties exist and it exceeds the composite by >1, draws 'Weighted average − Vitals = Final' math; returns y+8.

branches.effect: draws the math line (+14); else nothing

flags.text: Recomputes ScoreBreakdown.gapFromFactors inline and labels the whole gap 'Vitals' whenever any penalty exists, even though the gap can also include baseline drift (which the doc comment says must not be labelled Vitals).

units.does: Builds the header info line: 'Date: <end-or-start date>  •  Recording: x.x min (n beats)' when the series has beats, else '… Summary import (no raw beat data)'.

branches.effect: durationMinutes 0 — unreachable since totalBeats>0 implies a series

units.does: Strokes the 8pt light-grey 270° gauge track from 135° to 405°.
Draws the 7pt 'Recovery' label below the gauge.
Frequency grid rows: VLF (if present), LF, HF, LF/HF (if present), Total, LF/HF n.u. (if both present).
Nonlinear grid rows: SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 always; ApEn, SampEn, DFA α1, α2 when present.
ANS grid rows: Stress Index, PNS, SNS, HRV Readiness (/10), Resp Rate, each only when present.
Quality grid rows: recorded beats, analysis-window minutes ('—' when unknown/0), window clean beats, artifact %.
